question: Across the four existing expanding chronological prefixes, what were corrected 1/5/15-minute direction scores and observed D1 GC history coverage in their own later quarters?
population: All parents in four predefined distinct Q1–Q4 2025 development quarters, TRAIN prefixes strictly preceding each quarter; no model retraining or selection.
method: Verify parent and target clocks/observation masks against corrected 60-head targets; rescore original saved 1/5/15 logits using corrected signs, strict terminal maturity and no ties. Reconstruct observed D1 volume count in each exact 252-row historical window. Report each horizon and simple baselines descriptively.
interpretation: Different expanding prefixes and different market quarters vary together. No causal claim about training exposure or D1 coverage, no independent holdout and no selection from reused development. Older three-head models were fitted to original float labels.
